title: A BELT-STOCKED HEAL STAYS IN THE BACKPACK GRID
why: A slip in the class keys build: the game pins what each throwable, medical and armour key shows when the raid starts and when he picks something up, and a pin hides one copy of its item from the backpack grid, so with a lone Bandage on key 7 the grid listed nothing to select, drop or offer a teammate with T, and the peddler would not buy those copies. Before the class keys a heal, a grenade or a plate was never pinned and the grid showed all of them. A pin the game makes by itself for a heal, a stim, a grenade or a plate no longer hides anything. A key he bound himself, and a gun on a gun key, hide a copy as before.
now: Heals, grenades and plates the belt stocks by itself stay listed in the backpack grid again.
